inputs.title: Distributed Transaction Ordering Protocol
inputs.description: An asynchronous Byzantine fault tolerant state machine replication system that eliminates leader bottlenecks.
inputs.mechanism: Nodes exchange threshold cryptographic signatures over peer-to-peer gossip channels with DAG ordering.
inputs.components: Gossip communication module, DAG ledger buffer, threshold signature verifier, state machine committer.

inputs.title: Adaptive Compliant Gripper Assembly
inputs.description: A robotic end-effector capable of passively adapting to irregular geometry objects without motor overload.
inputs.mechanism: Tendon-driven articulated fingers coupled through differential planetary gearing with torsional spring compliance.
inputs.components: Mounting flange, planetary differential gear train, three articulated finger segments, elastomer grip pads.
